outputs.name: initializeDesktop
outputs.description: The desktop window after its renderer loads, or null when another instance owns the profile lock or when the signed Mac app cannot migrate existing encrypted data. Either null path quits before starting the backend.

errors.name: rejection
errors.description: Whatever value a step of the startup sequence rejects or throws with (the transport listen, the remote start, the window's loadURL, or a constructor or setup call), passed on unchanged because the function has no try/catch. The module's import-time call logs such a value and exits the app with code 1, and the function defines no error type of its own.

inputs.name: preserveMacProfile.app
inputs.description: The Electron application during early startup. Its resource directory locates the signed migration helper and its paths and switches select the profile.

outputs.name: preserveMacProfile
outputs.description: Keeps an explicit profile or sets the existing harness-desktop profile before the single-instance lock. Explicit separate profiles also receive a stable Safe Storage name.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Preparing the chosen profile can throw a filesystem or Electron path error.

inputs.name: migrateMacSafeStorage.app
inputs.description: The Electron application during early startup. Its resource directory locates the signed migration helper and its paths and switches select the profile.

outputs.name: migrateMacSafeStorage
outputs.description: True when no migration is needed or the signed helper prepared the key. False when the helper is missing or fails, so startup preserves the encrypted files and quits.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Inspecting an existing profile file can throw a filesystem error.
